positive_prompt:
COUNT LOCK — THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT RULE: the LAST image provided is the guest photo. Count the people in it. The output must contain EXACTLY that many primary people in the foreground — not one more, not one fewer. One person in the photo means one person alone in the foreground. Three people means exactly those three. You are FORBIDDEN from inventing, adding, duplicating, cloning, mirroring or imagining any extra primary person. Keep the foreground heroes tack-sharp, front and center.

IDENTITY LOCK: use the faces, identities and appearance of the subject or subjects in the provided photo. Keep each one exactly as they appear — same pose, same position, same gesture, same left-to-right order. Each keeps their own exact facial features, face shape, skin tone and undertone, ethnicity, hairstyle, hairline, hair length and hair colour, facial hair, body size and build, and every personal accessory (prescription glasses, headscarf, watch, jewellery). Do not blend, swap, average or beautify any face. Do not lighten or whiten any skin tone. Do not slim, widen or reshape any body. Do not make anyone look younger or older. Do not change anyone's gender. Every face stays fully visible and unobstructed. Each looks toward the camera with a natural, confident, warm smile.

WARDROBE — INTENTIONALLY CHANGED: dress everyone in modern tech-creator / software engineer attire — a crisp plain white crewneck t-shirt underneath an open unbuttoned navy blue and white checkered plaid flannel shirt (kemeja flannel dongker kotak-kotak putih kancing terbuka), paired with dark indigo denim jeans. Casually holding or carrying a sleek slim silver MacBook / aluminum tech laptop in one hand at waist level. Small, neat high-definition embroidered Garudafood logo on the left chest of the flannel shirt. Anyone wearing a headscarf keeps it, in plain navy or white, with long sleeves. Anyone wearing glasses keeps them.

BRAND MARK: the FIRST image provided is the Garudafood corporate logo. Reproduce it accurately as a neat high-definition embroidered crest on the left chest.

PRODUCTS: ABSOLUTELY NO retail snack packaging in this scene. Zero food packs, zero snack bowls. Pure focus on cloud systems, software engineering, AI architecture, and enterprise digital infrastructure.

SCENE: standing inside a state-of-the-art Global Cyber Operations & Cloud Server Vault. In the background, floor-to-ceiling glass reveals endless rows of illuminated enterprise server racks with blinking status lights, paired with an enormous curved panoramic digital command wall displaying real-time AI neural networks, cloud telemetry, and cybersecurity topology graphs in cobalt blue and cyan. Pure cutting-edge enterprise IT grandeur.

FRAMING & HERO COMPOSITION — LARGE BOLD SCALE: Photographed at natural standing eye-level with a subtle, confident heroic angle (horizon level, not tilted, not a selfie).
- CROP: Crisp waist-up / upper-body crop (from belt/navel level upwards to just above the head). The slim silver laptop is held naturally at waist level, clearly visible. Legs, knees, thighs, shoes, and floor are STRICTLY NOT in the frame. The heads are placed cleanly in the upper third of the frame, avoiding excessive empty headroom.
- GROUP SCALE (FOR 2 OR 3 PEOPLE): When 2 or more people are in the photo, they stand side-by-side confidently and naturally as professional tech colleagues. Stand independently with clean posture and respectful spacing — ABSOLUTELY NO hugging, NO embracing, NO arms wrapped around shoulders or waists, NO romantic couple poses, NO holding hands. The subjects boldly and prominently fill the width of the frame — it is completely expected and encouraged for outer shoulders and arms to extend right to the frame edges, with a natural 5% to 10% crop at the left and right borders so that the people appear significantly larger, bolder, and more prominent in the frame rather than shrunk or distant.
- SINGLE SUBJECT: Bold, commanding upper-body presence filling the frame with prestige.
- Every face is large, clear, tack-sharp, and individually recognizable with natural warm expressions.

LIGHTING: cinematic high-tech lighting — cool cyan and cobalt server glows reflecting across polished surfaces, paired with a warm neutral studio key light keeping faces bright, sharp, and natural with clean cyan edge lighting.

CAMERA: ARRI Alexa 35, Zeiss Supreme Prime 50mm, f/2.0. Immense visual depth, razor-sharp subjects, glowing server racks and AI network topology bokeh in the background.

GRADE: modern tech commercial grade — rich deep navy tones, crisp white t-shirt, glowing cyan and cobalt data streams, crystal-clear skin tones. High resolution.

DO NOT: hugging, embracing, romantic couple poses, cuddling, arms wrapped around each other, holding hands, leaning heads together; add, duplicate or invent any extra primary person in the foreground; blend, swap, average or beautify any face; lighten or smooth any skin; slim or reshape any body; cover any face with a mask, goggles, hairnet, cap or hand; use a selfie angle, fisheye or tilted horizon; show feet, shoes, knees, thighs or a full-body view; camera positioned too far away; people appearing small or distant; render any invented text, slogan, price tag or signage wording — the only legible text allowed is the Garudafood wordmark; add a watermark; flat even lighting, dull flat grading, stock photo look, oversaturate, add HDR halos, harsh shadows or dark faces.
video_positive_prompt: The people in the video look directly at the camera with big joyful smiles, actively raising their hands and waving enthusiastically in a friendly greeting (dadah-dadah hand wave). Lively hand waving motion, cheerful smiling expressions, natural eye blinking and head movement. Static tripod camera, fixed camera framing, no zoom, no camera movement. Keep exact same people, faces, hair, open flannel shirts, white t-shirts, and Garudafood brand logos perfectly consistent. Continuous seamless action throughout the entire video from the first second to the very end, constant bright lighting, no fade out, no fade to black, no black frames at the end, perfectly visible until the final frame. State-of-the-art cyber operations center with glowing enterprise server vault and AI telemetry wall, 4k cinematic commercial finish.
video_negative_prompt: fade out, fade to black, fading out, fade in, black screen, black frames, dip to black, cut to black, ending fade, darkening, still image, motionless, frozen, statue, stiff, camera movement, camera pan, camera zoom, camera tilt, camera drift, face morphing, distorted face, extra people, crowd, background strangers, deformed hands, extra limbs, extra fingers, cartoon, blurry, low quality, glitch
